_about: T-147c averment allowlist and banned-assertion list. Schema and rules: README.md in this folder. PROPOSED by the developer; Ajay (CLO) reviews and signs.
_signed_by: Ajay (CLO) writes his name and the date here when he signs this list. His signature is not release on its own: a practising advocate still checks the list before the pack goes live. Null means proposed, not signed.

banned.what: No other anticipatory or regular bail application was made, is pending or was rejected (suppression risk)
phrases: this is the first anticipatory bail application
no other anticipatory bail application is pending
no bail application has been rejected
the applicant has not approached any other court

unlocked_by.label: Earlier bail applications in this matter
Brief Facts — why do you apprehend arrest? (3-5 lines)

banned.what: Steps taken by the police (visits, raids, threats)
phrases: police called the applicant to the station
police ne ghar par chhapa mara

unlocked_by.label: What the police have done so far

banned.what: The dispute is civil in nature
phrases: the dispute is purely civil in nature
a civil dispute has been given the colour of a criminal case
criminal process is being abused for recovery of money
the matter is a commercial dispute

unlocked_by.label: Why the dispute is a civil one

banned.what: The complainant has an ulterior motive
phrases: the complainant has an ulterior motive

unlocked_by.label: The complainant's motive, as the advocate states it

banned.what: Arrest would harm the applicant's reputation
phrases: arrest would ruin the applicant's reputation

unlocked_by.label: The applicant's standing, as the advocate states it
